title: Instance
description: The contents of `nvmod-instance.json`: an Instance and the base copy it points at.

base.description: The absolute path of the base copy. Never written to.

executables.description: The programs `nvmod run` starts through the staged view (MO2's `customExecutables`). Absent when empty.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's layout; see [`INSTANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION`].

storefront.description: The storefront found when the Instance was made.

target.description: What the Instance runs on. Absent in a file of schema 1, which migrates to `vanilla`.

Executable.description: One entry of an Instance's executables registry.

arguments.description:
The arguments as one string, split on spaces with double quotes grouping words. `%DATA%` is the staged
`Data` folder, `%INSTANCE%` the Instance folder and `%PROFILE%` the profile name.

binary.description: The program, as a path on this machine (a `.exe` runs through Proton on Linux).

hidden.description: Whether front ends leave the entry out of their lists.

steam_app_id.description: The Steam app id the program runs under; the game's own id when absent.

title.description: The name `nvmod run` takes; unique in the Instance, compared without regard to case.

working_directory.description: The folder to run in; the program's own folder when absent.

Storefront.description: Where a base copy came from.

oneOf.description: No marker of a known store. Not supported.

Target.description: What the Instance runs on: the vanilla engine with the script extender DLLs, or nv-rs with them built in.

oneOf.description: The original engine (Proton on Linux, native on Windows); xNVSE and JIP LN are external DLLs.
The nv-rs engine port, which has xNVSE and JIP LN built in.
